title: Reynolds Pentad and Severe Cholangitis: Why It Matters
subject: Medical Triads

sections.title: Recognize the pattern
points: Reynolds pentad adds hypotension and altered mental status to Charcot triad of fever, jaundice and right upper quadrant pain.
The pentad suggests severe cholangitis with circulatory or neurologic involvement.

sections.title: What this finding does—and does not—mean
points: Sepsis resuscitation, source control and urgent evaluation for biliary drainage are essential principles.
Elderly or immunocompromised patients may show nonspecific presentations rather than the complete eponym.

sections.title: Memory aid
points: Reynolds pentad: Charcot triad plus hypotension and altered mental status.
It signals severe disease, but waiting for all five findings would be unsafe.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Do not wait for all five features before escalating a patient with suspected severe biliary sepsis.
